source.edition: David Pingree, Hephaestionis Thebani Apotelesmaticorum Epitomae Quattuor, Vol II, Teubner 1974
source.relationship: Epitome IV recensional witness printed from Greek manuscripts marked I/J/K/M in the apparatus; distinct textual class relative to main manuscript P, but not an independent author or predictive corroboration.

saturn_subdivision.locus: Epitoma IV section 37, printed pages 240-241, physical PDF 270-271
saturn_subdivision.proportional_source_method: Convert Saturn's 30 months to 900 days; divide by 129 month-total ~ 7; take approximately seven times the period of each planetary recipient. Text expressly calls this an approximation.
saturn_subdivision.apparatus_warning: Pingree Epitoma IV printed p240 apparatus at line 23 onwards warns that some numbers are corrupt; these numerals are transmitted/edited, not an authenticated autograph.

year_five_days.locus: Epitoma IV section 37, printed p242 PDF 272
year_five_days.language_evidence: Epitoma text explicitly instructs counting the five-day period along with twelve months of each year.
year_five_days.separate_kind: A parallel recension of main Book II.29, not an independent astrologer's validation.

year_365.locus: Epitoma IV section 44, printed p264 PDF 294
year_365.direct_source: The year is expressly counted as 365 days in the Greek text, not merely derived from a sum.
year_365.limitation: Within a different recension, not proof that all main-text 52/57, 140/150 and finer-subdivision conflicts share one stable numerical correction.
